purpose: BM25F content-relevance scorer (SSOT): tokenises title/abstract/keywords with NFKD normalisation, computes per-pool IDF, applies phrase/proximity boosts, capability-gated citation tiebreak and thin-source prior; also exports hasContentMatch and applyConfidenceGate.
notes: Quarantined v0.44 (engine teardown, sprint_log_v0_44 D-4): source preserved at docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/. Virtual record kept so cross-refs resolve. Prior notes: D1/D2/D5 are FIXED in current source. D3/D4 partially fixed (client UI path uses RRF; server path still raw BM25F). IDF is per-pool over 14-45 docs — degenerate by design until v0.35 T2 server extension.

purpose: Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion: scale-free merger of native, lexical, and semantic rank lists; also provides buildNativeRanks (per-source dense rank map) and nativeWeight (pool-size-aware native share).
notes: Quarantined v0.44 (engine teardown, sprint_log_v0_44 D-4): source preserved at docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/. Virtual record kept so cross-refs resolve. Prior notes: Used by hooks.useSemanticRerank (client). Not yet called by api.search (server) — F-209 open gap.

purpose: On-device embedder client: owns the embed.worker singleton, builds the title+abstract+keywords text (700-char budget), prefixes the QUERY with the arctic-embed query instruction, embeds query+docs in one batch and returns a cosine similarity per result; per-id embedding cache for load-more.
notes: Revived v0.49 (sprint_log_v0_49 §2) from docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/ — rewritten, not restored verbatim. Model: Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-xs (22 MB quantized, CLS pooling, English-only, Apache-2.0). Cannot run server-side (Web Worker) — F-205 remains the documented API gap.

purpose: Web Worker running Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-xs via @xenova/transformers@2.17.2 from jsDelivr; CLS pooling + L2 normalize; posts model download progress, then embedding arrays. Browser-cached after first load.
notes: Revived v0.49 (sprint_log_v0_49 §2) from docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/ — rewritten, not restored verbatim. Verified 2026-10-17 against the HF repo: onnx/model_quantized.onnx = 22,972,992 bytes; 1_Pooling/config.json pooling_mode_cls_token=true.

purpose: Fetches and JSON-parses Moby Thesaurus shards off the main thread; caches parsed shards in-worker and replies with an entries array the main thread rebuilds into a Map.
notes: Quarantined v0.44 (engine teardown, sprint_log_v0_44 D-4): source preserved at docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/. Virtual record kept so cross-refs resolve. Prior notes: Added v0.42 (F-207): moves the ~4MB 'c'-shard JSON parse off the main thread. lib.synonyms falls back to an inline main-thread fetch when Worker is undefined (SSR/tests).

purpose: Once every adapter settles, scores the pool on-device (lib.semantic) and returns a copy of sectionStates with `_sim` on each result, ordered by it per section; incremental on load-more, resets on new search, clears on toggle-off, falls back to native order on error.
notes: Revived v0.49 (sprint_log_v0_49 §2) from docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/ — rewritten, not restored verbatim. No RRF/slider any more: pure semantic order behind ONE toggle (settings.semanticSearch). App.jsx layers rerankedStates over useSearch state and holds resultsReady until status is done|error.

purpose: Result identity and deduplication: doiKey (strongest), titleFingerprint (fuzzy same-paper); dedupFirstWins for streaming (first-occurrence wins), dedupHighestScore for pooled (highest _score wins).
notes: v0.42: dedupHighestScore replacement is now O(1) via a posMap (F-206), and a collision ENRICHES the survivor with the loser's better fields via mergeRecords (F-210, the sprint's "F-208") instead of discarding it. Pooled path only — dedupFirstWins (streaming) cannot merge. Covered by src/lib/dedup.test.js.

purpose: Isomorphic identifier resolution (detectIdType, resolveIds, canonicalDoi) over the NCBI PMC ID Converter, with a shared token-bucket limiter (key 'ncbi_eutils'); feeds the pre-dedup DOI canonicalizer (v0.43 T2.2, attacks v0.35 D5 fragmentation) and /api/ids.
notes: Clean-room from neuromechanist/opencite id_converter.py + base.py (MIT). No Node-only imports — fetch/performance.now are global in Node ≥18 and browsers. Mixed-type batches rejected by NCBI; inputs are split into homogeneous groups with explicit idtype before each request. 429 returned as a JSON body (not just HTTP status) — parsed defensively; the whole batch is treated as unresolved rather than throwing. Process-local token bucket: limits per warm Vercel instance, not globally (same caveat as adapterHealth.js).

purpose: Clusters book-chapter results under their container/book title for the source-view layout; non-chapter results pass through as single-item groups.
notes: Render-time only — not called during scoring or dedup.

purpose: Generates MLA 9, APA 7, CSL-JSON, BibTeX, and RIS citation strings from NCR records; returns segment arrays for MLA/APA to enable inline italic rendering without an HTML parser.
notes: Never called at search time — only on render (MLA/APA display) and user action (export dispatcher).

purpose: Maps ISO 639-1, ISO 639-2, and full English language names to a canonical {code, display} pair; returns null for undetermined/undifferentiated codes.
notes: Used by adapters to normalise language codes from API responses.

purpose: Score-side term expansion (original query to APIs unchanged): 16 hand-curated academic clusters (synchronous) + Moby Thesaurus II letter-keyed shards (async, CDN-fetched, shard-cached).
notes: Quarantined v0.44 (engine teardown, sprint_log_v0_44 D-4): source preserved at docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/. Virtual record kept so cross-refs resolve. Prior notes: MAX_MOBY_SYNS=24 cap. Shard files are large (some letters >2MB JSON). v0.42 (F-207): loadShard now fetches+parses inside workers.synonyms.worker off the main thread, with an inline main-thread fallback when Worker is undefined (SSR/tests).

purpose: nDCG@10, MRR, and Recall@N metrics engine for the F2 Gold-Set Regression Harness in the admin console; grades results against a DOI/title → relevance-grade label map.
notes: Unit-tested in goldSetMetrics.test.js. Imported by components/admin/GoldSetHarness.jsx — NOT orphaned. Not called during live search. v0.44: recall@k stays meaningful post-teardown; nDCG/MRR measure upstream order only.

purpose: Controlled-vocabulary enumerations: ADAPTER_CATEGORY (core/extension) and TAG_VOCAB (region/archiveType/contentType display labels).
notes: Not part of the scoring pipeline — used by adapters and UI tag system.
